_note: The economy (Economy): one currency, gold, and construction points (CP). Every figure is a month unless it says otherwise. Income is each province's base income (from its people at the start: per_million gold a month for each million, to the power exponent, so a small province earns a little more for its size), plus civilian factories and ports, times mobilization, blockade and war support. Expenses are the army (each unit's upkeep, military.json), the navy, the buildings' upkeep and interest on debt. CP is a stockpile: construction sectors add to it every day; starting a building spends its gold and CP at once, and it is finished after a fixed number of days. One project at a time in a province; at most max_level of each building in a province.

income._note: per_million and exponent: base income. civilian_factory and port: gold a month a level (buildings). mobilization_loss: base income lost at full mobilization. blockade_factory_loss: share of factory income a full blockade takes (it takes all port income). occupied_share: share of a province's base income its occupier collects (its owner gets none of it).

construction._note: capital_cp: CP a day a nation's capital makes (so a nation that has lost every construction sector can still build). max_level: the most of one building in a province. Every nation starts with at least one civilian factory and one construction sector (Economy.load_scenario).

buildings._note: Province buildings. gold and cp are paid when a level is begun; days is how long it takes; upkeep is gold a month a level; income is gold a month a level; cp_per_day is CP a day a level. requires 'coastal' needs a sea coast. defense, shell_reduction and hard_reduction are the works' effects in battle, per level (Military.works_defense). The railway gives supply and faster marching (Military) until the logistics hub replaces it.

start._note: Starting buildings (Economy.load_scenario) come from the scenario's own (data/scenarios/*/scenario.json, buildings); a nation with none gets one civilian factory and one construction sector in its capital.

debt._note: Interest a year on what a nation owes (a treasury below zero), as a share of the debt, paid monthly.

_standing_share: The most men a nation may keep under arms in peace, as a share of its manpower pool (Economy.standing_cap). The player sets the standing army below it; the AI's grows with its people and output (army_growth_share).

mobilization._note: Mobilization is a single lever, 0 to 1. In peace it may go up to peace_max; at war it may go to 1 and never falls below the war floor of data/diplomacy.json.
